g.text: Input: fanout line above the crossbars
Output: spread zone then horizontal crossbars

polyline.data-label: fanout line: all fanout vias remain above this boundary
D0: left through gap 0 (visual offset only)
D1: right through gap 1 (visual offset only)
D2: left through gap 0 (visual offset only)
D3: right through gap 1 (visual offset only)
D0: right through gap 2 (visual offset only)
D1: left through gap 1 (visual offset only)
D2: right through gap 2 (visual offset only)
D3: left through gap 1 (visual offset only)
